plan: A huntress who pokes with her javelins then turns into a cougar to pounce on her prey.
aSurveiller: Her Q (Javelin Toss). The farther it travels, the more it hurts: stay behind your minions, it stops on the first one hit.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: her javelin (Q) stops on the first one hit.
If a javelin hits you, back off: she can pounce farther onto you as a cougar.
Avoid her traps (W) in bushes: they reveal you.
forces: Javelins that hurt a lot from range.

sorts.P: Faster in bushes; marks hunted targets.
sorts.Q: Javelin stronger from far; powerful strike as a cougar.
sorts.W: Trap that reveals; pounce as a cougar.
sorts.E: Heals an ally; area swipe as a cougar.

momentFort: The early game is her most important phase: she invades and steals camps. Protect your jungle with wards.
